title: P6a — Transformer-Side Jacobian Spectroscopy (Schwarzian soft mode)
note: K3 kill condition met (reparam overlaps < 0.001 for all n=2..6, both corpora). But this is a methodology failure: the measured Jacobian object (partial A^(ell+1) / partial h^(ell), residual-stream to attention-weight) is not the correct analog of the SYK dressing-map Jacobian (partial G^(ell+1) / partial G^(ell), bilocal-to-bilocal). Zero overlap is expected when the measured object is wrong, regardless of physics. Not a falsification of P6a.

protocol.models: GPT-NeoX 6L/8H/d_k=64: C-NAT-anon s0 (exp-096, step_2000) and C-alien s0 (exp-097, step_2000)
protocol.note: Layer 5 skipped (ell+1=6 >= N_LAYERS=6). Fallback corpus texts used (no text files in Modal volumes). Summary_builder queried layer 5 (null); actual data is at layers 3,4.

H_S2_degeneracy.note: Unexpected: C-alien (UV-arrested) shows more degeneracy than NAT-anon (IR-converging). C-alien deg_ratio ~0.90-0.93; NAT-anon ~0.76-0.84. Plausibly due to UV-arrested attention's simpler local geometry producing a more symmetric Jacobian.

H_S3_reparam_overlap.note: All overlaps < 0.007, far below kill threshold < 0.1. Overlap flat across n=2..6 (no n-structure). This is consistent with the measurement object being wrong, not with physics falsification.

H_S4_gap_closure.note: Both corpora show gap closure with depth (consistent with approach to fixed point for both). NAT-anon gap much smaller than alien at same layer (0.109 vs 0.667 at layer 4) — consistent with NAT-anon being nearer to the fixed point.

H_K4_alien.note: C-alien does NOT show the K4 pattern (it shows H_S2=True, not collapsed overlaps from zero degeneracy). C-alien shows unexpected degeneracy.

sigma_top_comparison_layer4.interpretation: NAT-anon's attention-update Jacobian has a much larger top singular value (63% larger than alien). Means the map is more nearly norm-preserving in NAT-anon — consistent with being closer to a non-trivial fixed point.

gap_closure_with_depth.interpretation: Both corpora show increasing lambda_top with depth. The corpus-conditioned gap structure is different: NAT-anon is 6x smaller gap than alien at layer 4, reflecting fundamentally different spectral regimes.

unexpected_degeneracy_inversion.interpretation: UV-arrested model (C-alien, peaked local attention) has more degenerate Jacobian than IR-converging model. Possibly reflects that peaked local attention creates a nearly-isotropic Jacobian in head-space.

diagnosis.why_zero_overlap: The measured Jacobian J = partial A^(ell+1) / partial h^(ell) maps from residual stream R^{seq x d_model} to attention weight space R^{n_heads x seq x seq}. Its left singular vectors (in output=attention space) are determined by which attention patterns respond most to residual-stream perturbations. These are architecture-dominated (layer norm, W_Q, W_K structure) and have no reason to align with the theoretical causal-strip reparameterization modes. The correct SYK Jacobian is partial G^(ell+1) / partial G^(ell) — a bilocal-to-bilocal map where both input and output are attention weights. This cannot be computed directly from the residual-stream Jacobian without inverting the QKV mechanism.
diagnosis.redesign_needed: exp-104: measure partial G^(ell+1) / partial G^(ell) via attention-hook injection: perturb attention weights at layer ell directly (by adding a small delta_G to A^(ell) before the output projection), measure change in A^(ell+1). This operationalizes the dressing-map Jacobian correctly.
